title: Hands-on Example: Writing a Simple ROS 2 Node (rclpy)
description: This chapter provides a step-by-step guide to writing and running a basic ROS 2 node using rclpy, focusing on the core structure and interactions. We'll create a simple "talker" node that periodically publishes a message, similar to what we explored in the publisher/subscriber basics, but with a focus on the full node implementation process.
